title: Where LLM Agents Fail and How They can Learn From Failures
authors_zh: Kunlun Zhu、Zijia Liu、Bingxuan Li、Muxin Tian、Yingxuan Yang、Jiaxun Zhang、Pengrui Han、Qipeng Xie、Fuyang Cui、Weijia Zhang、Xiaoteng Ma、Xiaodong Yu、Gowtham Ramesh、Jialian Wu、Zicheng Liu、Pan Lu、James Zou、Jiaxuan You
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: AgentErrorBench releases 200 annotated failed ALFWorld, WebShop, and GAIA episodes with a 17-type taxonomy, minimal root causes, and feedback, while annotation agreement and replay metadata remain material audit limits.
AgentErrorBench 发布 200 条带标注的 ALFWorld、WebShop 与 GAIA 失败轨迹，含 17 类错误分类、最小根因与纠正反馈；标注一致性与回放元数据仍是主要审计缺口。
why: It turns failed agent rollouts into structured supervision for step/module detection, causal localization, feedback generation, and recovery, preserving the distinction between environment success and judgment-based diagnosis.
inclusion_reason: A concrete failure-trace taxonomy and trace-to-root-cause-to-feedback audit pipeline.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A long agent episode may contain many downstream symptoms after one early mistake. Flat error enumeration therefore does not identify which decision caused terminal failure or what feedback would permit recovery. The work separates AgentErrorTaxonomy, AgentErrorBench, and AgentDebug.

The reusable data object is a failed environment episode augmented with decision-step module text, error labels, a minimal critical root cause, supporting evidence, corrective feedback, and subsequent re-rollout outcome. The official repository links a 200-episode AgentErrorBench release; this is distinct from the larger pool of more than 500 failures examined while forming the taxonomy.

长时程 agent 在一次早期错误后可能出现许多下游症状，因此平铺列举错误不能回答哪一步导致终局失败，也不能说明什么反馈可促成恢复。该工作区分 AgentErrorTaxonomy、AgentErrorBench 与 AgentDebug。

可复用数据对象是带增强字段的失败环境 episode：决策步模块文本、错误标签、最小关键根因、支持证据、纠正反馈和后续 re-rollout 结果。官方仓库链接了 200 条 episode 的 AgentErrorBench；它不同于建立 taxonomy 时分析的 500 余条失败池。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AgentErrorTaxonomy defines 17 error types across memory, reflection, planning, action, and system modules. Ten annotators use it to mark decision steps and identify the minimal root-cause set rather than every cascading symptom. AgentDebug then performs module-level analysis, selects the earliest critical error, writes actionable guidance, and re-executes from that point until success or the attempt limit.

Two feedback contracts must remain separate. ALFWorld, WebShop, or GAIA supplies the environmental terminal outcome. Error type, causal importance, evidence span, and feedback quality require human or LLM judgment. A successful re-rollout can test usefulness of guidance, but does not retroactively prove every diagnostic label correct.

AgentErrorTaxonomy 在 memory、reflection、planning、action 与 system 五个模块中定义 17 类错误。10 名标注者据此标记决策步，并识别最小根因集合，而不是穷举所有级联症状。AgentDebug 再做模块级分析、选择最早关键错误、生成可执行指导，并从该点重新执行，直至成功或达到尝试上限。

必须分开两类反馈契约：ALFWorld、WebShop 或 GAIA 提供环境终局结果；错误类型、因果重要性、证据片段和反馈质量依赖人工或 LLM 判断。Re-rollout 成功可检验指导的实用性，但不能反向证明每个诊断标签都正确。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors analyze more than 500 failed trajectories, then curate 200 representative episodes: 100 ALFWorld, 50 WebShop, and 50 GAIA. Ten graduate annotators with NLP and LLM-agent experience review each decision step. Guidelines are refined over three pilot rounds; annotators receive training, a shared subset is independently double-annotated, and disagreements are adjudicated collectively. Module-level Cohen's kappa is 0.55.

AgentDebug has three operational stages: map each step's memory, reflection, planning, and action content to taxonomy types; identify the earliest critical error; generate feedback and re-roll out from that point, refining feedback on continued failure. The paper reports GPT-4.1 at temperature 0 for critical-error detection. The repository provides detectors, provider wrappers, vendored environment adapters, rollout collection, and step-to-episode conversion. Exact benchmark revision, generating-model mixture, sampling yields, reset state, and per-episode attempt histories remain unknown.

作者先分析 500 余条失败轨迹，再精选 200 个代表性 episode：ALFWorld 100、WebShop 50、GAIA 50。10 名具有 NLP 与 LLM-agent 经验的研究生审阅每个决策步；指南经三轮 pilot 调整，标注者先接受训练，共享子集独立双标，分歧再集体裁决。模块级 Cohen's kappa 为 0.55。

AgentDebug 有三个运行阶段：把每步 memory、reflection、planning、action 内容映射到 taxonomy；定位最早关键错误；生成反馈并从该点 re-rollout，若仍失败则细化反馈。论文在关键错误检测实验中使用 temperature 0 的 GPT-4.1。仓库提供 detector、provider wrapper、内置环境适配、rollout 收集和 step-to-episode 转换；确切 benchmark 版本、生成模型混合、筛选产率、reset 状态与逐 episode 尝试历史仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest data evidence is the documented annotation process and official release link: 200 selected episodes, ten trained annotators, three pilot rounds, double annotation on a shared subset, adjudication, and kappa 0.55. Appendix examples expose fields such as task, critical module and step, evidence, observation, memory, reflection, plan, and action.

The paper reports 24.3% versus 0.3% all-correct localization and 45.0% versus 28.0% step accuracy against its strongest baseline, plus up to 26% relative task-success improvement after feedback. These results test the diagnosis/recovery system. They do not show that all annotations are stable, that the 200 cases represent environment-wide failure rates, or that the data licence and replay package are complete.

最强的数据证据来自已说明的标注过程与官方发布链接：200 个精选 episode、10 名受训标注者、三轮 pilot、共享子集双标、裁决，以及 kappa 0.55。附录示例还展示 task、critical module/step、evidence、observation、memory、reflection、plan 与 action 等字段。

论文报告 all-correct 定位为 24.3% 对 0.3%，step accuracy 为 45.0% 对 28.0%，反馈后任务成功率最高相对提升 26%。这些结果检验诊断/恢复系统，不能说明全部标注稳定，也不能把 200 个案例当作环境总体失败率，更不能证明数据许可与回放包完整。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The main data contribution is causal compression of failure supervision. Earlier failure analyses often enumerate surface errors; AgentErrorBench asks which minimal early error explains the cascade, and retains evidence and actionable guidance. AgentDebug connects that structured diagnosis to an executable recovery loop.

Error taxonomies, self-reflection, and post-hoc retry are not individually new. The direction signal is the joint record contract linking module-local labels, root-cause selection, feedback, and environment re-execution. Reuse should preserve both judgment provenance and terminal outcomes rather than collapsing them into one quality score.

主要数据贡献是对失败监督做因果压缩。既有失败分析常枚举表面错误；AgentErrorBench 追问哪一个最小早期错误解释了级联失败，并保留证据与可执行指导。AgentDebug 再把结构化诊断连接到可运行的恢复循环。

错误 taxonomy、自我反思和事后重试本身并非新组件；方向信号在于联合记录契约，把模块局部标签、根因选择、反馈与环境重执行连起来。复用时应同时保留判断来源与终局结果，不能压缩为单一质量分。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The 200 failures cover only three environments and were selected for representativeness, so label frequencies are not population estimates. Root-cause annotation is counterfactual and causal: different prompts, models, tools, resets, or admissible actions may change which step is deemed decisive. Kappa 0.55 indicates material disagreement despite training and adjudication.

The paper's algorithm labels critical detection as an LLM operation without rollouts/counterfactuals, while nearby prose describes stepwise counterfactual substitution; the exact implementation boundary should be audited. The official Drive release is verified, but dataset-specific licence, immutable revision, checksums, split manifest, provider/model lineage, environment pins, and complete recovery histories remain unknown. Recovery gains are not annotation-quality proof.

200 个失败仅覆盖三个环境，且按代表性选择，因此标签频率不能视为总体估计。根因标注具有反事实与因果判断性质；不同 prompt、模型、工具、reset 或 admissible action 可能改变哪一步被视为决定性错误。尽管经过训练与裁决，kappa 0.55 仍表明显著分歧。

论文算法把关键错误检测标为无需 rollout/counterfactual 的 LLM 操作，邻近正文却描述逐步反事实替换，确切实现边界需要审计。官方 Drive 发布已核验，但数据集专属许可、不可变版本、checksum、split manifest、provider/model 谱系、环境固定信息和完整恢复历史仍为 unknown。恢复增益不是标注质量证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For rollout_search_test_time_trace_data, AgentErrorBench supports training or evaluating step/module detectors, root-cause localizers, evidence selectors, feedback generators, and failure-aware recovery policies. A robust derivative record should keep task ID, environment revision, observations, admissible actions, internal module text, terminal outcome, all step labels, selected roots, evidence, feedback, annotator/adjudication metadata, and every re-rollout outcome.

Auditors can compare symptom labels with minimal causes, measure agreement by module and error type, and test whether feedback succeeds under the same or changed agent/environment. Report annotation reliability separately from recovery success, pin the data snapshot, and verify upstream licences before redistribution.

对 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 而言，AgentErrorBench 可用于训练或评估步骤/模块 detector、根因定位器、证据选择器、反馈生成器与失败感知恢复策略。稳健的派生记录应保留 task ID、环境版本、observation、admissible action、内部模块文本、终局结果、全部步骤标签、选定根因、证据、反馈、标注/裁决元数据和每次 re-rollout 结果。

审计者可比较表面症状与最小根因，按模块和错误类型统计一致性，并测试反馈在相同或变化后的 agent/环境中是否仍有效。标注可靠性与恢复成功率应分开报告；再分发前还应固定数据快照并核验上游许可。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate the 200 released annotated failures from the more than 500 trajectories examined during taxonomy development.
  • Five modules contain 17 controlled error types; environment success is a different signal.
  • Ten annotators use training, three pilots, double annotation, and adjudication; module-level kappa is 0.55.
  • Audit the LLM-versus-counterfactual boundary in critical-error detection.
  • Pin the Drive snapshot, dataset licence, provider/model, environment, and complete re-rollout history.

• 区分发布的 200 个标注失败与建立 taxonomy 时分析的 500 余条轨迹。
  • 五个模块含 17 类受控错误；环境成功是另一种信号。
  • 10 名标注者采用培训、三轮 pilot、双标和裁决；模块级 kappa 为 0.55。
  • 审计关键错误检测中 LLM 判断与反事实测试的实现边界。
  • 固定 Drive 快照、数据许可、provider/model、环境与完整 re-rollout 历史。
